note: Live controls for the repository root: the darwin cross-vet's neighbours, the release configuration and the CI workflows. What is mutated here is a config file rather than a Go branch, because the config IS the production artefact — a `-X` naming a symbol that does not exist, a files: entry naming a file that is gone, a trigger that no longer matches the tag, and a workflow that respells the gate are all defects whose only production surface is YAML. Scope these by control name: the root package's path is `./.`, which `just mutate .` matches against every package in the tree rather than this one. Seeded by 3u4hv.

controls.clause: Every `-X` in the release config names a package-level var this tree declares, because `go build -X missing.Symbol=v` drops the stamp silently and ships the compile-time default (3u4hv)
The release config and the justfile's build recipe stamp the same set of variables, so a binary's provenance does not depend on who built it (3u4hv)
The release stamps a `v`-prefixed version, because goreleaser strips the tag's leading v while `just build` stamps `git describe` verbatim — without it the same commit has two spellings (3u4hv)
The release publishes linux and darwin and nothing else, matching the one other GOOS portability_test.go cross-vets (3u4hv)
The release publishes amd64 and arm64, which the README, the changelog and the release skill all promise as four archives (3u4hv)
Every files: entry the archives ship is in this tree, because goreleaser aborts on a missing one after the tag is already pushed (3u4hv)
The release workflow triggers on a `v*` tag; a trigger that stops matching is silent, since pushing the tag then does nothing and leaves no failed run to notice (3u4hv)

The release checkout sets `fetch-depth: 0`: a shallow one leaves goreleaser no tag history for the changelog and the toolchain no repository to embed vcs.revision from, which is where `drops version` reads the commit (3u4hv)
CI runs `just test-all`, the documented gate, rather than a weaker recipe under its name (3u4hv)
No workflow spells the gate out itself; a second spelling is free to drift from the justfile, and a hand-rolled `go test` step drops the DROPS_DB tripwire silently (3u4hv)
controls.new:
- name: Gate
        run: go test ./... -race && just test-all
